questions.question:
Which of the following groups of letters when sequentially placed from left to right will complete the given series?

cd_fc_efcdefcde_cdefcde_cdef
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: cd_fc_efcdefcde_cdefcde_cdef

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) efdf → cd__e__f/c__f__ef/cdef/cde__d/__cdef/cde__f/__cdef

Option 2) cddf → cd__c__f/c__d__ef/cdef/cde__d/__cdef/cde__f/__cdef

Option 3) **edff** → cd__**e**__f/c__**d**__ef/cdef/cde__**f/**__cdef/cde__**f/**__cdef

Option 4) fcde → cd__f__f/c__c__ef/cdef/cde__d/__cdef/cde__e/__cdef

Here, out of all options 'edff' followed a pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (3)".

questions.question:

3. CONFIRM

4. CONFLICT

questions.question: Six boys Sumit, Gopal, Honey, Ishaan, Jatin and Lalit are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. Ishaan is the third to the left of Sumit. Jatin and Honey are the immediate neighbours of Ishaan. Lalit is to the immediate right of Jatin. Who is sitting to the immediate left of Honey?
questions.solution:
**Given :** Six boys Sumit, Gopal, Honey, Ishaan, Jatin and Lalit are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. 

**Explanation :**

1) Ishaan is the third to the left of Sumit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f280eb5a17558404ae593e6cf101d3d22e5f3fa4aa00643f2fe621fd1d07092f.png] 

2) Jatin and Honey are the immediate neighbours of Ishaan.

3) Lalit is to the immediate right of Jatin.

After positioning Jatin, Honey and Lalit only one position is left which will be occupied by the only boy left i.e Gopal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88c063da33481993091a35684cbb97a3057c7dc4930248a9cfbaa5b30a4ff49b.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Gopal is sitting to the immediate left of Honey.

Hence, **"Gopal"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement I :** Some engineers are doctors.

**Statement II : **All doctors are lawyers.

**Statement III : **Some lawyers are not teachers.

**Conclusion I :** Some lawyers are teachers.

**Conclusion II : **Some engineers are lawyers.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a54af98689fc02a2ad8cb541068eefc24bc8fe0f2aa7ff9a2767379f7809632.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some lawyers are teachers → Does not follow (As, Some lawyers are not teachers. So, it is possible but not definitely true.)

II. Some engineers are lawyers → Follow (As, Some engineers are doctors and all doctors are lawyers. So, some part of engineers is common with doctors which whole comes in lawyers, therefore it is definitely true.)

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (2)".

questions.question: If P + Q means P is the brother of Q. P × Q means P is the mother of Q. P ÷ Q means P is the father of Q and P - Q means P is the sister of Q. If A × B ÷ C - D + E - F, then how is A related to E?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 ×
 ÷
 -
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Mother
 Father
 Sister
 
 

 

**Given:** A × B ÷ C - D + E - F

So,

 
• A × B → A is the mother of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cecae6902277e6a5a805cdef9f4f454f73e04f7457b3c86c36d468923382d151.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0727392bc23f4bac7b016f8984f3b0e6d82bece79cfb4241131bd3266a33b73f.png] 

 
• B ÷ C → B is the father of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdd84acb327b94f9692f3ae9124fe558d74cbc16d6a5bb9fb27b7b0b6fe4e843.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a542512ee53abecfc689b99df6bbc1d0f45bcaa59f2ccd4568212f63c8497c7.png] 

 
• C - D → C is the sister of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b83b2e2218a5dc387b8c46b21c0989b50d811a6ce28f6893a57c660ea56da0f4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/faceb72968589fe6f8f3a9a7eb9210bbf4591c567b4057223e06021a8eb240ad.png] 

 
• D + E → D is the brother of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ed15d99130a0fbc4744f310e51d8b9436d14a4f6ccd4ad755d3d8692a8bf27b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9b74a5c279f5de4f14753291936853358a68deb17f876c725aeb3211d74069d.png] 

 
• E - F → E is the sister of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26840b0b58e09597292e371b4d4eac8aac68bff28fd451b00a0065812148322f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc96e7f3b1b5905392d4f94b9762c875e027fa37ba811ffdd9ef7a8eac8c37eb.png] 

So, A is the 'paternal grandmother i.e father's mother' of E.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (1)".
